description: Fetches available time slots for a Calendly event type within a future time range of at most seven days; results are not paginated.

inputSchema.description: Request model for fetching available times for a Calendly event type.

end_time.description: End datetime (exclusive) of the requested availability range, in UTC ISO 8601 format (e.g., 'YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ'). The duration between start_time and end_time cannot exceed 7 days.
end_time.title: End Time

event_type.description: The URI of the event type for which to find available times. This can be obtained by listing event types or from an event type object.
event_type.title: Event Type

start_time.description: Start datetime (inclusive) of the requested availability range, in UTC ISO 8601 format (e.g., 'YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ'). Must be in the future.
start_time.title: Start Time

inputSchema.title: ListEventTypeAvailableTimesRequest

name: list_event_type_available_times

AvailableTimeSlot.description: Model representing an available time slot for booking.

end_time.description: End time of the available slot in ISO 8601 format (e.g., 2024-01-20T09:30:00Z).
end_time.title: End Time

invitees_remaining.description: Number of invitees that can still be booked for this time slot (relevant for group events).
invitees_remaining.title: Invitees Remaining

scheduling_url.description: URL that can be used to schedule this specific time slot, embedding the final page of the booking flow where invitees enter their information.
scheduling_url.title: Scheduling Url

start_time.description: Start time of the available slot in ISO 8601 format (e.g., 2024-01-20T09:00:00Z).
start_time.title: Start Time

status.description: Status of the time slot availability.
status.title: Status

AvailableTimeSlot.title: AvailableTimeSlot

ListEventTypeAvailableTimesResponse.description: Response model containing the list of available times for the event type.

collection.description: Array of available time slots for the specified event type.
collection.title: Collection
